review.scope: Completion-bound P001 readiness or discussion through shared campaign pipeline; original-review recovery and proposal-only boundaries. Review source plus current host inspection as configuration evidence, not deployed execution of this change. Reconcile prior recovery suggestions; no live grant or patient launch.
findings: VERIFIED (prior-suggestion reconciliation): both accepted e9232aff suggestions are implemented — recover_projection refuses a projection nested under the original (FRESH_RECOVERY_PROJECTION_REQUIRED now covers output.resolve().is_relative_to(original.resolve())) and the original request.json must bind the exact broker event and packet hash (RECOVERY_ORIGINAL_TURN_BINDING_REQUIRED). The earlier MINOR context-derivation race is effectively closed: completed_pipeline re-derives grounding/evidence hashes at advancement and requires equality with both request.json and receipt input_sha256, so drift between recovery-time verification and execute's re-read fails closed at the gate.

VERIFIED (completion binding and installed authority): campaign packets exist only via enqueue_report when task_state.completed_job equals the installed trigger_job with trigger verified-completion and execution_proposal None (CAMPAIGN_COMPLETION_BINDING_REQUIRED); stage_result re-verifies the task-id digest over source/packet/report, exact equality with root-owned campaign_preparation, task_contract-derived campaign_artifacts, and refuses synthetic successors (CAMPAIGN_TASK_REFUSES_SYNTHETIC_SUCCESSOR). The broker's model_output_format independently re-validates the version-1 P001 readiness/discuss contract. No new socket operation, credential, admission grant, scheduler, or patient route is added; admission and the SUPERVISED turn budget remain broker-enforced.

VERIFIED (fail-closed recovery semantics): recovery=True clients accept only stage_status (RECOVERY_MODEL_CALL_FORBIDDEN); any non-COMPLETE original stage raises HOSTED_CAMPAIGN_BLOCKED_RECONCILE_NO_RETRY before the projection directory is created; an incomplete projection blocks (CAMPAIGN_RECOVERY_INCOMPLETE_NO_RETRY); read_only or non-zero-position absence blocks (CAMPAIGN_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN_NO_RETRY); and Coordinator.recover interrogates only stages with STARTED rows, so a task blocked before any stage started requeues without inventing a model call. Missing evidence never becomes a retry.

VERIFIED (identity bindings and privacy): every replayed or fresh answer is re-checked against requested_model per stage, exact claude-fable-5 actual_model for review, answer_sha256, packet_sha256 versus the caller packet, and operating_context_sha256 format; the broker enforces exact event equality, symlink refusal, per-file receipt re-hashing, controller-uid peer check, and named-code-only refusals. preparation_workspace copies only materialized tracked files, verifies every copied input hash on each reuse (CAMPAIGN_WORKSPACE_INPUT_CHANGED), and provenance records carry only receipt/context hashes — original consoles and prompts stay in the protected turn root.

VERIFIED (preservation of scientific approvals): a REVISE original review permanently blocks — execute writes no receipt at the enforced max_rounds=1, completed_pipeline additionally requires verdict APPROVE, round 1, exact artifact set/hashes, and status REVIEWED_PROPOSAL_NOT_ADOPTED — so recovery cannot convert a negative review into approval; conflicting or symlinked round-1 originals refuse before projection creation (RECOVERY_PRESERVES_CONFLICTING_ORIGINAL); grounding/predecessor pins, proposal-preview refusals, and the two-round default for existing campaign_pipeline callers are unchanged.

SUGGESTION (uncaught subprocess errors in recovery path): subprocess.CalledProcessError/TimeoutExpired from the git ls-files call in preparation_workspace is absent from the exception tuples in Runtime.recover and the tick phase loop (ValueError/KeyError/TypeError/OSError/sqlite3.Error), so a git failure while recovering a campaign task crashes the tick invocation instead of recording a runtime block. Fail-closed and evidence-preserving, but add subprocess.SubprocessError to those tuples or convert it to a named ValueError inside preparation_workspace. Related: '-c safe.directory=' is only honored in Git >=2.38 protected command scope; on older git a split-ownership checkout fails here rather than working as commented.

SUGGESTION (residual recovery-marker ambiguity from prior review): a crash between execute writing the projection's receipt.json and recover_projection writing immutable recovery.json leaves a projection that stage_result silently accepts as output with no top-level recovery marker; auditability then rests on the recovered_original:true per-stage provenance files hash-bound into artifact_sha256. Requiring recovery.json to exist whenever output==projection in stage_result/completed_pipeline (or writing an intent record before run_pipeline) would make the state unambiguous, completing the third prior suggestion.

SUGGESTION (configuration cross-validation): nothing at Runtime startup checks that the installed campaign_preparation trigger_job is not also a completion_bridge pair with a configured successor; that combination makes ingest build an execution_proposal and enqueue_report then permanently raises CAMPAIGN_COMPLETION_BINDING_REQUIRED, blocking the completion's ingestion until reconfiguration. Also verify that orchestrator.public_export.text's default limit in Coordinator._receipt accommodates the up-to-80000-byte campaign stage answers now persisted in coordinator receipts — that module was not supplied to this review and local tests only exercised small fixtures.

SCOPE NOTE (configuration evidence, not deployment): HOST_RECONCILIATION_R2 shows the broker in SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE mode with max_model_turns 3, the handover-controller service inactive with no campaign_preparation, publication, or report schedule configured, and installed sources differing from this development head. This APPROVE covers source readiness of the completion-bound preparation change only; it asserts no hosted execution, grants no live writer/limiter/unattended authority, and leaves patient launch and all separately gated decisions untouched. Source-only review; no tests were executed by this reviewer.

attribution: Actual author-operated Claude source review; configuration inspection is not hosted execution proof.
